Rina (CSM): Kicking off Meridian QBR cost pulse. They want a compact burn snapshot, two cost scenarios (embed pilot spike + steady growth), and a 30-min enablement + one-pager. Can we pull daily last-60d split by feature?
Owen (FinOps): Need baseline monthly $ estimate and remaining committed credits. Recommend soft alert at +25% vs baseline and hard at +50% or credits <12%. Also propose an emergency embed throttle rule.
Dee (Data): I can pull it. SQL I'll run: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) as day, feature, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM usage WHERE account='meridian' AND ts >= now() - interval '60 days' GROUP BY day,feature ORDER BY day; ETA ~90m.
Marco (AM): FYI customer is planning a similarity-search pilot next sprint; embeddings could 1.8-2.2x. They asked for a "budget-safe" rollout checklist.
Rina (CSM): For deck: 1) current burn + model mix, 2) Scenario A: 2x embed for 30d, 3) Scenario B: steady 6% monthly growth for 3 months, 4) alert/runbook + enablement one-pager.
Owen (FinOps): I'll draft the one-pager: quick wins = increase batch size, enable prefix caching, reduce embed dim where acceptable, and sample autoscale policy. Will add instructions for snoozing alerts during demos.
Dee (Data): Raw last30d: gen=61,000,000 tokens, embed=24,500,000 tokens. Uploading CSV to /shared/qbr/meridian_tokens_1777.csv and will run two forecast variants mapping tokens->$ using mix: gen $0.00065/token, embed $0.0012/token.
qbr-bot: CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qbr/meridian_tokens_1777.csv  automated baseline forecast (+11%) appended.
Rina (CSM): @Dee please include scenario outputs with dollar deltas and runway in months. @Owen add monitoring config with `snooze_window` and manual spike approval flow (ticket id + TTL).
Dee (Data): Will include charts and note if any dev/test spikes were filtered. ETA ~2h for uploads.
Marco (AM): Tentatively scheduled enablement Fri 9am PT (30m demo + 15m ops Q&A). I'll confirm with customer and collect dev key windows to help filter.
Rina (CSM): Action items: Dee (CSV + scenarios + charts), Owen (one-pager + monitor + playbook), Marco (confirm session), Rina (assemble slides). I'll share draft by tomorrow 9:30am PT. :thumbsup:
qbr-bot: QBR checklist updated: "Meridian cost scenarios + enablement one-pager" assigned to Rina, due in 14 hours.
